title: Cell-Cell Communication Network Analysis of Tertiary Lymphoid Structures in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
snippet: Tertiary Lymphoid Structures (TLS) are associated with a favorable prognosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC). However, the mechanisms governing their formation, particularly the existence of breast cancer subtype-specific critical cell communication networks, remain unclear.
